$description: Night theme (dark) system defaults. Same keys as day.tokens.json. Role colors are aliases, so a brand only overrides what its palette needs.

surface.$description: Page background. A neutral near-black: maroon stays an accent, never the room.

surface-sunk.$description: Wells, table stripes, quiet section backgrounds.

surface-raised.$description: Small lifts on Night: a hovered tab. Cards, panels and overlays stay on surface and are drawn by their outline.

fill-hover.$description: Hover wash behind neutral controls: secondary and ghost buttons, nav items, menu rows.

fill-pressed.$description: Pressed wash behind neutral controls, one step past fill-hover.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons. 15.6:1+ on Night surfaces.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text: intros, hints, metadata. 7.8:1+ on Night surfaces.

ink-disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls. Deliberately below 4.5:1; never use it for anything a person must read.

line.$description: Decorative hairlines and the 2px outline of neutral cards and panels.

line-control.$description: Input and checkbox borders at rest. 3.4:1+ on Night surfaces.

line-strong.$description: Hover border on cards, secondary button border, the selected tab rule.

primary-edge.$description: primary as a 3px outline on the surface: primary-toned cards, stats and bands. Must reach 3:1 on surface; a dark primary lifts on Night.

secondary-edge.$description: secondary as a 3px outline on the surface. Decorative: the box's filled label carries the meaning.

tertiary-edge.$description: tertiary as a 3px outline on the surface. Decorative: the box's filled label carries the meaning.

spotlight-edge.$description: spotlight as a 3px outline on the surface. Decorative: the box's filled label carries the meaning.

accent-edge.$description: accent as a 3px outline on the surface. Decorative: the box's filled label carries the meaning.

primary-mark.$description: The watermark color of a primary-toned box, shown at opacity-watermark: the second plume in its tone pair.

secondary-mark.$description: The watermark color of a secondary-toned box, shown at opacity-watermark: the second plume in its tone pair.

tertiary-mark.$description: The watermark color of a tertiary-toned box, shown at opacity-watermark: the second plume in its tone pair.

spotlight-mark.$description: The watermark color of a spotlight-toned box, shown at opacity-watermark: the second plume in its tone pair.

accent-mark.$description: The watermark color of a accent-toned box, shown at opacity-watermark: the second plume in its tone pair.

primary-tint.$description: A pale primary wash behind soft primary tags, with ink text (4.5:1+). Defaults to surface-sunk.

secondary-tint.$description: A pale secondary wash behind soft secondary tags, with ink text (4.5:1+). Defaults to surface-sunk.

tertiary-tint.$description: A pale tertiary wash behind soft tertiary tags, with ink text (4.5:1+). Defaults to surface-sunk.

spotlight-tint.$description: A pale spotlight wash behind soft spotlight tags, with ink text (4.5:1+). Defaults to surface-sunk.

accent-tint.$description: A pale accent wash behind soft accent tags, with ink text (4.5:1+). Defaults to surface-sunk.

action.$description: Primary button fill, checked controls, the selected-row bar. primary on Day, spotlight on Night, where a dark primary would sink into the page.

action-pressed.$description: action while pressed: one step past hover.

selected.$description: Where you are: the active tab, nav item, page and filter chip. A spotlight wash, never the action fill, so it never reads as a button.

link.$description: Inline links on any surface (4.5:1+). Underlined, always.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px gap in the surface color (3:1+ on surface).

success.$description: Success text and icons on surfaces and on success-tint.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on surfaces and on warning-tint (4.5:1+).

danger.$description: Error text and icons on surfaces and on danger-tint.

success-tint.$description: Wash behind success notices, banners and success tags.

warning-tint.$description: Wash behind warning notices, banners and warning tags.

danger-tint.$description: Wash behind error notices, banners and danger tags. Ink on it 4.5:1+.

chart-1.$description: First chart series, and the only color of a single-series chart.

chart-4.$description: Fourth and last series. Often below 3:1 on Day surfaces, so never alone and always with its numbers in text.

chart-other.$description: Every series past the fourth, grouped as Other, and the rest of the data when one series is highlighted.

overlay.$description: Things that float only: menus, dialogs, sheets and toasts. Cards on the page use borders, not shadows.
